questions.question: I bought a Fernhill Cloud annual plan two months ago. Can I get a refund?
evidence: After 30 days, we refund the unused months

grade.reference: Yes, a partial refund: the unused months, minus a 15% early-cancellation fee.
grade.rubric: Pass if the answer says that, two months after purchase, the customer gets the unused months back minus a 15% early-cancellation fee. Mentioning that a full refund is only possible within 30 days is fine. Fail if it says no refund is possible, or that a full refund is still available.

questions.question: If I cancel my monthly plan, do I get this month refunded?
evidence: We do not refund the current month

grade.reference: No. The current month isn't refunded, but you keep full access until the end of the billing period.
grade.rubric: Pass only if the answer says the current month is not refunded. Saying that access continues until the end of the billing period is a plus, not a requirement. Fail if it says the month is refunded.

questions.question: I'm moving from the Team plan to Starter halfway through my annual plan. Will I get money back on my card?
evidence: added to your account as credit

grade.reference: No. The difference is added to your account as credit. It is not refunded to your card.
grade.rubric: Pass only if the answer says the difference becomes account credit and is not refunded to the card. Fail if it says the money goes back to the card.

questions.question: We picked the EU region when we signed up. Can we move our files to the US later?
evidence: The region cannot be changed later

grade.reference: No. The region is chosen when the team is created and cannot be changed later.
grade.rubric: Pass only if the answer says the region can't be changed after the team is created. Fail if it says the files can be moved.

Will camera upload use my mobile data?
evidence: By default it only runs on Wi-Fi

grade.reference: Not unless you allow it: camera upload only runs on Wi-Fi by default, and mobile data can be turned on in Settings.
grade.rubric: Pass if the answer makes clear that camera upload doesn't use mobile data unless you allow it in Settings. Fail if it says camera upload uses mobile data by default.

questions.question: What happens if someone enters the wrong passcode too many times?

grade.reference: After 10 wrong attempts, the app signs out and removes offline files from the device.
grade.rubric: Pass only if the answer says the app signs out after 10 wrong attempts. Saying offline files are removed is a plus. Fail if it gives a different number or a different consequence.
